Today's free summary of "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
2782.headline: The prize mix in this game

2783.body:
"30X The Cash" is new from the Texas Lottery. It is a $2 game with five top prizes of $30,000. Nothing big has been won yet because almost no one has played it. This page will show it when that changes.

The numbers for "30X The Cash" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2783.headline: A brand-new game to watch

2784.body:
"Lucky Scratch" just went on sale in Texas. The game has eight full prize levels with four top prizes of $100,000. Every scratcher starts this way and loses prizes as it sells. You are seeing this one before that starts, when it is easiest to judge.

The numbers for "Lucky Scratch" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
2784.headline: New game, all prizes left
